launch_authorization: Implemented and unit-tested only; no fit has been started by the author. A real run requires the user's explicit decision and a passed --preflight-only on the training host.
design_source: CLAUDE_V25_RESULTS_AND_NEXT_DESIGN_20261025.md section 6 (suggestion only); reviewed and frozen in docs/KELMARSH_ANCHORED_RESIDUAL_V26.md; deviations from the suggestion are listed in design_deviations
question: Keeping the v25 data, queue, scaler, residual-branch architecture, loss, optimiser, schedule and per-fit budget, does replacing 'predict power from scratch' by 'frozen same-fold v20 DLinear forecast + zero-initialised TSMixerBasicSmall residual' beat that DLinear on internal selection without harming lead 1, and is any increment attributable to the six auxiliary channels (same-parameter PowerOnly residual)?
single_change_vs_v25: v25 forecast y = r(x). v26 forecast y = b(x) + r(x): b is the frozen same-fold v20 seed-2024 DLinear forecast (power slot, eval, no gradient); r is the unchanged TSMixerBasicSmall with only its final Linear(24->4) weight and bias set to 0. Because epoch 0 is now identical to the reference, the untrained epoch 0 is recorded but not selectable (design_deviations[0]).
novelty_claim: none; residual learning on top of a frozen forecaster is standard practice and not a paper contribution
inner_allocation: unchanged v20/v25: fit = target windows ending before calibration_early_end (90% of outer train); selection = targets inside [calibration_early_end, train_end); history may precede the stage; identity verified against the v20 DLinear contract window hashes
scaler: unchanged v20/v25 StandardScaler fitted on rows before base_fit_end (first 60% of outer train), all seven channels, verified by exact array comparison against the anchor's contract; not refitted
evidence_scope: development evidence only, not an independent confirmation; the anchor's epoch was itself chosen on this internal selection split in v20; extra seeds cannot restore independence
residual_targets_are_in_sample: the anchor was trained on the same fit windows, so the residuals the branch learns on fit are training-internal residuals; they are never called out-of-fold and never certify anything

reference.use: frozen anchor executor of both candidate arms AND the reference arm; never retrained

v25_historical.use: report-only historical columns on the identical inner selection cohort (from-scratch TSMixer); never gated, never retrained, never resumed; absent or changed files only drop the columns

anchor.output: power slot (index 6) of the DLinear forecast

residual.initialization: TSMixerBasicSmall.reset_parameters (identical RNG draws to v25), then head.weight = 0 and head.bias = 0

candidate.combination: standardized power: y_h = b_h + r_h; no gate, no learned or fixed scale, no clipping
candidate.rng_policy: seed_all(seed); residual constructed first with the same draws as v25 TSMixerBasicSmall; anchor constructed inside torch.random.fork_rng(devices=[]) (no global draws) and overwritten by the frozen checkpoint
candidate.epoch0_identity: before any optimiser step the forecast equals the frozen DLinear forecast: per sample on CPU in A0 (max abs diff exactly 0 in standardized and kW space) and at the start of every fit on the fit device against the registered CPU replay (per-sample max abs diff <= epoch0_identity_tolerance_kw, which only absorbs CPU/GPU float32 rounding; a wrong anchor or a non-zero head differs by orders of magnitude more)

AnchoredPowerOnly.role: same-parameter information ablation; never an outer fallback
AnchoredPowerOnly.mask: standardized channels 0..5 set to exactly 0 before BOTH the anchor and the residual; the anchor's power output is channel independent and therefore identical across arms

DLinear.role: frozen reference = the anchor itself; CPU replay only, never trained

paired_arms.initial_state: identical (verified by full state-tensor digest including the anchor)
paired_arms.rng_reset: seed_all(seed) before construction of every arm

training.optimizer_parameters: trainable residual parameters only (requires_grad=True); the anchor is excluded
training.loss_target: final forecast b + r (not the residual alone)
training.tie_policy: strictly lower MAE updates; ties keep the earlier epoch
training.fit_side_eval: after training, eval-mode metrics of the selected state on the fit windows (informational only; same scale as selection; never used for any choice)
training.same_recipe_as: v25 TSMixerBasicSmall / v20 DLinear (lr 0.001, weight_decay 1e-4, batch 64, 20 epochs, patience 5, clip 1.0, cosine T_max=20, 0.8 MAE + 0.2 MSE)

seeds.note: A2 seeds change only the residual initialisation and sample order; the anchor stays the frozen seed-2024 DLinear

stages.name: initial_information_pair
stages.order: f0 Full, f0 PowerOnly, f1 Full, f1 PowerOnly, f2 Full, f2 PowerOnly

stages.name: single_outer_development_evaluation
stages.anchor_executor_check: the anchor replayed on outer must reproduce the registered v20 DLinear outer predictions within replay_tolerance_kw

stages.name: independent_recomputation_report_stop
stages.outer_access: registered predictions only if A3 ran

G2.dlinear_reference: the single frozen seed-2024 anchor for every residual seed

gates.attribution_rule: an auxiliary-information increment may be claimed only if I1 (and I2 when A2 ran) is supported; G1/G2 alone support only a numeric improvement of the anchored recipe, which may come from re-parameterisation
gates.lead1_rule: declared before any v26 result: the lead-1 macro MAE and RMSE must not exceed DLinear's by more than the numeric tie tolerance; this is a new development target and does not rewrite the v25 gates
gates.interpretation: operational budget gates, not statistical or independent generalization proofs

statistics.seed_aggregation: average paired losses over seeds on the same windows; not an ensemble, not independent rows
statistics.primary_pvalue_family: three folds, seed-averaged AnchoredFull vs DLinear absolute-loss Newey-West tests
statistics.rmse_ci: issue-time block bootstrap of squared-error sums, sqrt per arm then difference

reporting.macro: equal fold-seed metric mean; skills computed per fold/seed first; macro error ratio named separately
disclosures: selected vs last vs epoch-0 selection metrics of every fit (harm after training is never hidden)
correction magnitude mean|y - b| and the share of points where the correction reduced the absolute error
fit-side eval-mode metrics of every selected state next to the anchor's fit replay (same kW scale)
v25 from-scratch TSMixer columns when its registered run is available and verifies
reporting.forecast_trace_rule: fold 0, seed 2024; smallest turbine; first 24 consecutive 3h issue times, else longest run (ties earliest); leads 1 and 4

design_deviations.suggestion: handoff 6.1/6.3: inherit 'epoch 0 included in selection'; a final epoch-0 choice counts as fallback/zero gain
design_deviations.frozen_choice: epoch 0 is recorded (it must equal DLinear) but is not selectable; selection runs over epochs 1..20 with patience counted from epoch 1
design_deviations.reason: Epoch 0 equals the frozen reference. Including it would guarantee non-inferior selection MAE, but would NOT make the strict joint-improvement G1 pass automatically: an exact tie fails. This protocol instead excludes epoch 0 to expose the performance of a trained residual even when every trained epoch harms the anchor. This is an explicit selection-policy difference from v25, not a correction of a tautological G1. The anchor and residual both use the historical selection split; their selection optimism is not known to be symmetric or removed.

design_deviations.suggestion: handoff 6.2: optionally carve an untouched calibration block for transferable certificates
design_deviations.reason: Calibration blocks and certificates belong to a later Wiki protocol bound to this exact executor; v26 only asks whether the numeric increment exists.

forbidden: extra seeds, architectures, gates, scales or real-data smoke candidates
retraining or fine-tuning the DLinear anchor
adding an observed selection bias back into predictions
future_not_in_this_execution: fit-side read-only diagnostics of the frozen v25 checkpoints (scripts/diagnose_kelmarsh_fit_side_v25.py)
cross-year metadata and exposure audit then a separately frozen confirmation protocol
new information budget: issue-time NWP, legal sub-hourly summaries, synchronized upstream turbines
new Wiki experts bound to the actual anchor/residual/memory/scaler/event/calibration identities
